comparisons.note: ABBA uses the mean of two process medians per source. Separation is descriptive, not a significance test. Actual binding ratios use separate single-process measurements.

diagnostics.note: Untimed source-paired reports verify enabled/original helper equality, full result metadata/cost/error prefixes and EXPLAIN choices. Allocation samples count Ruby objects with GC enabled; they are not timing measurements. No new retained cache is introduced.

cross.note: One fresh process per core; median of five samples. Cross-core checks rendered-value checksums/row counts, not exact costs/metadata. Existing collectors differ; exact binding verification is separate.

profiles.note: execute_prepared with the existing eager collector. All timings precede tracing. Allocations and call counts are diagnostic observations, not sampled CPU-time attribution.

host_address_space.note: The original host run failed under its virtual-address ceiling while observed RSS remained below the unchanged resident-memory guard. The diagnostic retains Linux reservation snapshots; the final host suite uses 2 GiB AS. Original failures and probe bytes remain intact.

host_sandbox.note: The sandbox blocked a local page-service Unix socket. The complete final host suite was rerun with the same resource guards and socket access; no assertion was waived.

harness_smoke.note: One untimed pre-pin fixture smoke, kept outside the 24 formal commands. No source or fixture correction was needed.
